name: Monsters vs. Aliens
description: Inspired by DreamWorks Animation's 2009 blockbuster feature film, this new series follows the further adventures of the beloved monsters- B.O.B., the gelatinous blob without a brain; Link, the prehistoric fish-man; Dr. Cockroach, the half-man/half-insect mad scientist; and Susan (aka Ginormica), the incredible growing woman-as they defend Earth from various alien and supernatural threats.

videos.title: Monsters vs. Aliens: B.O.B.'s Big Break
videos.overview: B.O.B. and his monstrous crew are on a mission to bust out of the government’s top-secret holding cell. Led by mad-scientist Dr. Cockroach Ph.D and macho amphibian The Missing Link, the trio outwits grizzled General W.R. Monger to make a triumphant escape ... almost.

videos.title: Monsters vs. Aliens: Mutant Pumpkins from Outer Space
videos.overview: Susan Murphy (a.k.a. Ginormica) and the Monsters are now working with the US government as special ops. So when an alien presence is detected in Susan's hometown of Modesto, California -- right before Halloween -- the team is dispatched to investigate. Everything appears normal, right down to the jack-o-lanterns peering out from every doorstep and windowsill. But when Halloween arrives, those innocent-looking carved pumpkins reveal themselves for what they really are mutant aliens. The altered pumpkins then start to implement their fiendish plan to take over Earth. The Monsters are there to combat the mutant gourds and try to smash their wicked scheme!

videos.title: Monsters vs. Aliens: Night of the Living Carrots
videos.overview: After a mutant alien pumpkin explodes on the Murphy's carrot garden, zombie carrots start attacking the immediate area, and it's up to the Monsters to save the night again.

videos.title: Welcome to Area Fifty-Something
videos.overview: All is well at Area Fifty-Something with Team Monster, until a lone alien imprisons the President and makes a permanent home on base.

videos.title: Danger Wears a Diaper
videos.overview: The president's birthday is here! Dr. Cockroach has made him a gadget that will make him appear younger, but instead blasts him to infanthood.

videos.title: The Toy From Another World
videos.overview: The Monsters snoop in Coverton's quarters, where they find his "cuddle bear", which then attacks everyone on B.O.B.'s commands.

videos.title: The Bath Effect
videos.overview: Susan makes B.O.B. think that baths cure crankiness - B.O.B. leaps into action, chasing after Coverton to cure his crankiness once and for all.

videos.title: The Fruit of All Evil
videos.overview: When Link accidentally eats the gelatin that B.O.B. calls his "girlfriend", it's up to the gang to figure out how to break the bad news.

videos.title: Frenemy Mine
videos.overview: B.O.B. is determined to have Coverton be his emergency buddy. Instead, Coverton chooses to manipulate B.O.B. to help him steal a death ray.

videos.title: Maximum B.O.B.
videos.overview: Impressed with B.O.B.'s indestructibleness, Coverton decides to clone a piece of him. After too many clones, B.O.B. alarmingly begins to diminish little by little.

videos.title: It Came... on a Field Trip
videos.overview: The Monsters find an alien called Sqweep in the woods doing an earth studies project, which has a lot of sensitive data that could be used for an invasion.

videos.title: Educational Television
videos.overview: It's all fun and games when Link and B.O.B. use Sqweep's tablet TV as a raygun, until a doomsday app is initiated that could destroy the planet.

videos.title: Flipped Out
videos.overview: B.O.B. discovers a secret switch that General Monger tells him not to touch. Will it get rewired before the Big Blue Blob can get to flip it?

videos.title: The Wormhole Has Turned!
videos.overview: Dr. Cockroach overpromises that he's made a teleportation machine. Instead he's made a short wormhole and tries to pass it off as the real thing.

videos.title: The Two Faces of Dr. Cockroach
videos.overview: Dr. Cockroach is split into two personalities by his new teleportation machine.

videos.title: The Thing with One Brain
videos.overview: Coverton installs an "evil" switch in a brain that Dr. Cockroach builds for B.O.B.

videos.title: Night of the Living Dog
videos.overview: Sqweep accidentally gives everyone except for B.O.B. the brains of a dog when he wants to do research on puppies.

videos.title: Attack of the Movie Night!
videos.overview: Sqweep creates a memory extractor which releases a monster from a scary movie.

videos.title: 98 Pound Cockroach
videos.overview: To get strong enough to pass an obstacle course, Dr. Cockroach tweaks his 50/50 man/roach genetic makeup so he'll be 40 percent man and 60 percent roach. Unfortunately, his roach side keeps increasing at the cost of his human side and its intellect, forcing his teammates to find a way to reverse the process.

videos.title: When Nature Shrieks
videos.overview: General Monger takes Susan, B.O.B. and Sqweep on a camping trip to the desert. But when a lightning storm destroys their supplies and Monger is injured, Susan must take charge to get them back to base.

videos.title: Vornicarn
videos.overview: When a vicious alien beast known as a Vornicarn hatches on Earth, the alien huntress Sta'abi arrives searching for it.

videos.title: It Got Out of Hand
videos.overview: Susan tries to prevent the monsters from destroying the base with a doomsday prank.

videos.title: The Sound of Fear
videos.overview: Dr. C's former teacher reveals a missing music grade in his transcript.

videos.title: The Sorry Syndrome
videos.overview: Susan accidentally gets Sta'abi hunting for her after learning that apologies are a mark of disgrace for her people.

videos.title: Speak Not the Q Word
videos.overview: After the monsters are informed that uttering alien swear words result in physical consequences, Coverton passes a list of those words B.O.B. to cause havoc.

videos.title: Screaming Your Calls
videos.overview: Coverton plans to use Dr. C's invention to hack the base's mainframe.

videos.title: The Time-Out That Wouldn't End
videos.overview: Monger puts Sqweep in time out for making a mess.

videos.title: Curse of the Man-Beast
videos.overview: The monsters hack into Monger's top secret files.

videos.title: It Came From Level Z
videos.overview: Monger orders the monsters to clean up the Rec Room.

videos.title: Number Seven!
videos.overview: Sqweep has to go "number seven."

videos.title: The Friend Who Wasn't There
videos.overview: Link pursues Sta'abi using a pheromone spray.

videos.title: Driven to Madness
videos.overview: Link and Sta'abi duel for driving privileges of a new car.

videos.title: The Beast From 20,000 Gallons
videos.overview: When an asteroid is detected heading for Earth, Team Alien is put in charge of the rocket being sent to destroy it. Meanwhile, Dr. C sends B.O.B. to play hide and seek. Unfortunately, he winds up hiding in the fuel being used to power the rocket, and Team Monster must rescue B.O.B. and alter the rocket's trajectory so it'll actually hit its target.

videos.title: The Sneezing Horror
videos.overview: Coverton tries to steal base secrets when everyone gets the alien flu.

videos.title: Prisoner of the Dark Dimension
videos.overview: Vornicarn's bad behavior lands him in the Isolation Zone.

videos.title: I Predict Horror
videos.overview: B.O.B. eats Dr. C's ``probabilitator'' and foresees Coverton with a crown.

videos.title: Destroy Chickie D!
videos.overview: Sta'abi is summoned to embark on her Warrior Vision Quest.

videos.title: The Mystery of Dr. Cutter
videos.overview: Dr. Cutter arrives to update the base's technology.

videos.title: The Partymobile That Invaded Earth
videos.overview: Link and Bob fix up an old spaceship and take it for a joyride.

videos.title: Ginormicat!
videos.overview: A stray kitten makes its way to the base and obtains Susan's ginormica powers.

videos.title: My Monster, My Master
videos.overview: Sta'abi recruits Bob to teach her the art of combat.

videos.title: It Came From Channel 5
videos.overview: When Derek returns, strange secrets begin to unfold.

videos.title: It Ruled With an Iron Fist
videos.overview: The monsters and the aliens are introduced to Rule-Bot when Monger goes away for the weekend.

videos.title: This Ball Must Be Dodged
videos.overview: Monger gathers everyone for a game of dodge ball.

videos.title: It Spoke With Authority
videos.overview: Dr. Cockroach creates a spray to give the president more authority.

videos.title: Debtor Alive!
videos.overview: The monsters begin to borrow from Sqweep's allowance.

videos.title: The Grade that Wouldn't Pass!
videos.overview: After Dr. C tampers with Sqweep's project, the alien receives a bad grade.

videos.title: You Can't Breathe in a Diner in Space!
videos.overview: Dr. Cockroach accidentally teleports the diner into space.

videos.title: Race to the End...Zone!
videos.overview: Link is disappointed when he can not play in the government football game.

videos.title: When Luck Runs Out
videos.overview: A leprechaun joins team Monster.

videos.title: That Which Cannot Be Unseen
videos.overview: After seeing something horrifying in Coverton's room, Team Monster must submit to memory wipes.

videos.title: Bride of the Internet
videos.overview: Susan tries to escape the Internet.

videos.title: The Invisible Threat! (Also Silent)
videos.overview: A  metal robot battles with the monsters and aliens.
